title: Taylor Swift Eras Inspired Home-10 min to Broadway
description:
Welcome to “The Eras Airbnb” an elegant Taylor Swift inspired home with each room capturing the magic of Taylor’s different eras. Perfect for Swifties, bachelorette parties, couples getaway, and families. The home sleeps 10 and is only 10 minutes from broadway!

~ Free Parking
~ Full kitchen w/ coffee station
~ Free high-speed WiFi
~ Neon signs & selfie light
~ Flat Screen TV'S in three rooms 
~ Clean and soft linens for each bed
~Fresh towels, shampoo, body wash and hair dryer
~Washer and Dryer

The space
As you walk through the door you will be brought into the “Folklore Era” decked out with a guitar, record player, flat screen tv and a custom made coffee table based off of Taylor Swift’s Folklore Grammy dress. The “Lover Era” has a king size bed, neon sign for photos, a flat screen TV and the “1989 Era” has a polaroid camera, comfy bunk beds as well as 1989 art/pillows and a neon sign. The most epic room in the home is the “Reputation Era” with a gold chandelier, large snake rug, flat screen tv and custom reputation artwork. There are two bathrooms, one has a shower and the other a shower/bath as well as a large backyard and two patio sets.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home.
